import pandas as pd


def _sig(city, tier):
    c = '' if pd.isna(city) else str(city)
    t = '' if pd.isna(tier) else str(tier)
    return c.rstrip() + '|' + t.rstrip()


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    dim = inputs["dim_member"].copy()
    stg = inputs["stg_member"].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtypes for working columns
    if "eff_end_date" in dim.columns:
        dim["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_end_date"])
    if "eff_start_date" in dim.columns:
        dim["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_start_date"])

    new_rows = []

    for _, s in stg.iterrows():
        mid = s["member_id"]
        mask = (dim["member_id"] == mid) & (dim["is_current"] == 1)
        cur_idx = dim.index[mask]

        if len(cur_idx) == 0:
            new_rows.append({
                "member_id": mid,
                "city": s["city"],
                "tier": s["tier"],
                "eff_start_date": s["update_date"],
                "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                "is_current": 1,
            })
        else:
            ci = cur_idx[0]
            c_city = dim.at[ci, "city"]
            c_tier = dim.at[ci, "tier"]

            if _sig(s["city"], s["tier"]) != _sig(c_city, c_tier):
                dim.at[ci, "eff_end_date"] = s["update_date"]
                dim.at[ci, "is_current"] = 0

                new_rows.append({
                    "member_id": mid,
                    "city": s["city"],
                    "tier": s["tier"],
                    "eff_start_date": s["update_date"],
                    "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                    "is_current": 1,
                })
            # else: no-op, unchanged record, no new version

    if new_rows:
        new_df = pd.DataFrame(new_rows, columns=[
            "member_id", "city", "tier", "eff_start_date", "eff_end_date", "is_current"
        ])
        dim = pd.concat([dim, new_df], ignore_index=True)

    # Final dtype normalization
    dim["member_id"] = dim["member_id"].astype("int64")
    dim["is_current"] = dim["is_current"].astype("int64")
    dim["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_start_date"])
    dim["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim["eff_end_date"])

    dim = dim.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"dim_member_out": dim}
